sources.title: What Is Freecash?
sources.claim: Get-paid-to platform connecting users with companies needing survey respondents, app testers and product reviewers; signup 30 seconds; instant login with Google or Facebook; supports PayPal, direct bank transfer, crypto and 20+ other cashout methods incl. gift cards; most users treat it as side income, not a replacement for a full-time job; rated 4.6 on Trustpilot from 326,947 reviews.
caveats: Trustpilot rating is a self-reported marketing claim.
Brief source S18.
sources.local_note: Freecash supports PayPal, direct bank transfer, crypto, and over 20 other cashout methods, including gift cards. Most users treat Freecash as a side income, not a replacement for a full-time job.

sources.title: Freecash Cashout page
sources.claim: Lists cashout brands: PayPal, Visa, Bank Transfer, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Dogecoin, Litecoin plus gift cards (Amazon, Apple, Google Play, Venmo, Steam, etc.). Embedded page configuration contains cashoutFeePayload rule: 5% PERCENTAGE user-facing fee for brands PAYPAL, VISA, VENMO, ACH.
caveats: Minimums, processing times, and per-region availability not shown on public (logged-out) page.
Fee rule read from embedded page config JSON, not visible copy; may be A/B or region specific.
Brief source S19.
sources.local_note: cashoutFeePayload rules: filters brand PAYPAL, VISA, VENMO, ACH; userFacingFee value 5, feeType PERCENTAGE.

sources.title: Freecash Terms of Service
sources.claim: Users must be at least 16; one account per person and one per household; Rewards (coins/points/dollar amounts) have no cash value until redeemed and are nontransferable; third-party Rewards Program affiliates may make final determination of offer completion; Almedia not obligated to award untracked offers; KYC may be required before first payout; right to hold offer credits up to 90 days; inactive accounts (1 year no login) may be closed and balances expire; users responsible for taxes; no VPN/proxy/emulator/VOIP numbers; optional PlayTime usage-access on Android; weekly lottery free.
caveats: freecash.com/terms and /tos redirect to homepage; real terms URL is /en/policies/terms.
Effective July 17, 2026.
sources.local_note: In some instances, Almedia's third-party Rewards Program affiliates, rather than Almedia, may make the final determination of whether an Offer has been successfully completed. We have a right temporarily to hold any offer credits up to 90 days after an Offer has been completed.

sources.title: Freecash homepage and FAQ
sources.claim: Sign up with Apple, Google, Facebook or email; optional SignUp code; claims 80M+ users, 4.5 avg app rating, $400M+ given back; FAQ: no one should promise you will get rich; most users earn a few dollars up to around $50 in a typical month; a small fraction earn more but 'pour in a lot of time and spend a lot of money'; PayPal and Venmo payouts usually process same day; gift-card codes within minutes; some payouts held for security/verification checks.
caveats: Marketing/self-published claim; not independent proof.
User counts and payout totals conflict with other official pages.
sources.local_note: most users earn somewhere from a few dollars up to around $50 in a typical month ... a small fraction of users do earn considerably more than that, but they pour in a lot of time and spend a lot of money to get there

sources.title: Is Freecash Legit?
sources.claim: Rewards platform since 2020; claims paid out over $200,000,000 to more than 80 million people; 4.7 App Store (96k+ ratings), 4.6 Google Play, 10M+ downloads, 4.7 Trustpilot from 150,000+ reviews; brands pay Freecash to introduce users and Freecash shares reward; 'It won't make you rich'; game reward confirms once the brand verifies; free to join; does not sell data.
caveats: Marketing/self-published claim; not independent proof.
Payout total and review counts contradict homepage (CR-FC-04) and CR-FC-01.
sources.local_note: It won't make you rich. It's spare-time rewards, not a paycheck. ... a game reward confirms once the brand verifies you hit the level.

sources.title: First Cashout Requirements
sources.claim: First withdrawal requires email verification, ID verification (Veriff, selfie + physical document, up to five minutes) and minimum threshold of $5-$20 depending on region; later withdrawals need no ID verification or threshold, only enough funds for the method (e.g. $5 PayPal, $0.10 Stake); PayPal/Venmo/ACH payouts arrive by email to claim; track in 'My Withdrawals'.
sources.local_note: The minimum threshold varies between $5-$20 depending on your region. For withdrawals after the first, you do not need to verify your ID or meet a minimum threshold ... (i.e. $5 for PayPal, $0.10 for Stake).

sources.title: How to Withdraw to PayPal
sources.claim: Most withdrawals processed through Tremendous (legacy Tango); PayPal withdrawals from $5 to $200 per transaction; 5% withdrawal fee on all amounts; PayPal email can differ from Freecash email; non-refundable confirmation; standard processing hold then Tremendous redeem email.
sources.local_note: PayPal withdrawals are available from $5 to $200. A 5% withdrawal fee applies to all amounts.

sources.title: Which countries can I cash out to PayPal from?
sources.claim: Lists ~120 countries where PayPal withdrawal is available, incl. United States, UK, Canada, Germany, India, Brazil, etc.
caveats: Page dated May 2025; may be stale.
sources.local_note: PayPal withdrawals are now available in more countries. Check out the full list below: United States of America, Albania, Algeria ...

sources.title: How to Make Bank Transfers
sources.claim: Bank transfer via Tremendous email link (ACH routing number, account number, type); 5% withdrawal fee; non-refundable; bank transfers take 2-4 business days; only available to US-based users; contact Tremendous if not received after 4 business days.
sources.local_note: Bank transfers take 2-4 business days to be processed. Note: You can only use bank transfer to withdraw your earnings if you are based in the US.

sources.title: How fast is a bank transfer cashout?
sources.claim: States bank transfers normally take about 3 business days and, in the same article, 3-5 business days; uses ACH batch processing; PayPal transfers usually instant; contact support if >5 days.
caveats: Internally inconsistent (about 3 vs 3-5 business days); older than CR-FC-09.
sources.local_note: Bank transfer withdrawals normal take about 3 business days. ... Bank transfers from Freecash take 3-5 business days, if you would prefer a quicker alternative, PayPal transfers are usually instant.

sources.title: How to make SEPA bank transfers
sources.claim: SEPA bank transfer available in AT, BE, BG, HR, CY, EE, FI, FR, DE, GR, IE, IT, LV, LT, LU, MT, NL, PT, SK, SI, ES; sent in EUR; 5% withdrawal fee; non-refundable; most instant, up to 5 working days; no longer available in CZ, DK, HU, PL, RO, SE.
sources.local_note: Select the checkbox to confirm you understand that Freecash charges a 5% withdrawal fee ... SEPA bank transfer (IBAN) withdrawals are no longer available in: Czech Republic, Denmark, Hungary, Poland, Romania, Sweden.

sources.title: How to withdraw to Venmo
sources.claim: Venmo withdrawal via Tremendous email claim; 'available from <$5' ; 5% fee on all amounts; non-refundable; first withdrawal requires ID verification; processing hold.
caveats: Minimum shown as '<$5' which appears to be a typo; exact minimum unclear.
Country availability for Venmo not stated.
sources.local_note: Venmo withdrawals are available from <$5. ... A 5% withdrawal fee applies to all amounts.

sources.title: How to cash out to Revolut
sources.claim: Revolut withdrawal using name + Revtag; Revolut KYC required; usually instant, approvals within 30 minutes; available in US, Australia, France, Italy, Netherlands.
caveats: Fee for Revolut not stated.
sources.local_note: Users can withdraw from Freecash using Revolut in the following countries: United States, Australia, France, Italy, Netherlands.

sources.title: How to withdraw Bitcoin
sources.claim: Direct BTC withdrawal to user address in USD amount, generally up to an hour, sometimes hours; Travel Rule sender details Almedia GmbH, Germany; also Stake.com (BTC) and Stake.us (US only, Stake Cash) withdrawals that are irreversible.
caveats: No crypto minimum or network fee stated.
Stake/Stake.us are gambling platforms.
sources.local_note: payments are not instant, they generally take up to an hour to arrive ... Sender name: Almedia GmbH; Sender country: Germany. Stake.us is only available in the US.

sources.title: Wrong Bitcoin address - can I get a refund?
sources.claim: Invalid address/username auto-cancels and returns funds; valid address or Stake username not controlled by user is final and unrecoverable.
sources.local_note: If you enter a valid address that you do not control, the transaction is final, and the funds cannot be recovered.

sources.title: Why Is My Withdrawal Still Pending?
sources.claim: PayPal, crypto and gift card withdrawals are instant with random security checks up to 30 minutes; bank transfer, Stash, Revolut up to 3 business days (manually processed); support cannot accelerate; check 'My Withdrawals'.
caveats: Read via WebFetch summarizer; wording paraphrased.
Conflicts with Revolut (CR-FC-13) and PayPal timing pages.
sources.local_note: PayPal, Crypto, Gift Card: instant with potential delays up to 30 minutes due to security checks; Bank Transfer, Stash, Revolut: up to 3 business days.

sources.title: Freecash Gift Cards Guide
sources.page_scope: Academy support article (instant cashback gift cards)
sources.claim: Users can purchase digital gift cards that give instant cashback (separate from gift card cashout options); select regions; activation up to 24 hours; purchases final and non-refundable except rare technical issues.
sources.local_note: Freecash now allows you to purchase digital gift cards that provide instant cashback, which are separate from the normal gift cards we offer as cashout options.

sources.title: Instant gift cards regions and countries
sources.claim: Instant cashback gift cards available in United States and Germany; others can use regular gift card cashout options.
sources.local_note: Instant cashback gift cards are currently available in the following countries and regions: United States, Germany.

sources.title: Why we remove cashout methods
sources.claim: Freecash removed a number of gift-card cashout options and occasionally removes methods that create the most issues; if a method is not visible it was probably removed.
sources.local_note: We occasionally simplify our withdrawal process, removing the cashout methods that create the most issues.

sources.title: How to withdraw Amazon gift cards
sources.claim: Amazon gift cards from $5; non-refundable checkbox; reward email with security code reveals code; country list (US, AT, AU, BE, CA, CZ, FR, DE, IN, IE, IT, JP, ...).
sources.local_note: On the Cashout page, you will find Amazon gift cards, starting from as low as $5.

sources.title: Free PayPal (Academy cashout landing page)
sources.claim: Shows estimate '240 min' using Freecash = $36.00 vs other platforms $12.00 (*earnings depend on location, activity, offer availability); fee structure table '5%', '3-5 Days', '~$5-$200'; first cashout minimum $5-$20 depending on region; availability depends on region.
caveats: Marketing/self-published claim; not independent proof.
Earnings estimate is marketing and must not be treated as an hourly wage.
sources.local_note: Min's using Freecash: 240 min; With $36.00*; Other Reward Platforms $12.00. Fee Structure 5%; Processing Time 3-5 Days; Payout Range ~$5-$200.

sources.title: How Offer Tracking Works
sources.claim: Completion data passes User Device > Game Provider > Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) > Freecash; if earlier stage fails Freecash gets no postback; Freecash monitors ticket spikes and offer health; support manually reviews and escalates to advertisers.
sources.local_note: Freecash sits at the end of a multi-step data chain. User Device > Game Provider > Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) > Freecash.

sources.title: Resolving uncredited offers
sources.claim: Freecash-hosted offers: up to 48 hours to credit, then open support ticket on offer; partner offers: contact the partner directly after 72 hours with Freecash ID, details, date, screenshots; partner response can take up to 35 days; missed completion time limits cannot be overridden; Freecash cannot speed up crediting.
sources.local_note: Offers Provided by Our Partners: When you have an issue, you need to contact the offer partners directly. It can take up to 35 days to receive a response from our offer partners.

sources.title: Exclusive offer no credit
sources.claim: It can take up to 72 hours for any offer to be credited; do not open a ticket until 72 hours have passed; ticket button grayed out until 3-day window passes since you started the offer; ticket needs date, screenshot evidence, comments.
caveats: Conflicts with 48-hour window in CR-FC-23 and CR-FC-25.
sources.local_note: It can take up to 72 hours for any offer to be credited. ... Do not open a support ticket unless 72 hours have passed since completion.

sources.title: How to create a support ticket
sources.claim: Ticket can be created 48 hours after beginning an Exclusive or Featured offer; time-limit misses cannot be overridden; needs date, screenshots, comments; support aims to resolve within 15 days; statuses Awaiting Support / Accepted / Declined; no tickets for Partner Offers.
caveats: Read via WebFetch summarizer; paraphrased.
sources.local_note: You can create a support ticket 48 hours after beginning an Exclusive Offer or Featured Offer ... No, you cannot create a support ticket for a Partner Offer.

sources.title: How long do tickets take to answer?
sources.claim: Support resolves tickets within 10 to 15 days; Gold VIP tickets prioritized and aimed within 24 hours; notification via bell.
sources.local_note: we will work to resolve it within 10 to 15 days. ... Tickets from Gold VIP members are given top priority ... within 24 hours.

sources.title: What evidence is needed for large rewards
sources.claim: Evidence required for tickets regardless of reward size; screen recording preferred; gaming offers: progress, in-app purchase receipts, account ID; subscription offers: proof of purchase; banking offers: proof of deposit; crypto offers: deposit slips, trading history, withdrawal confirmation; casino offers: deposit slips, wagering history, withdrawal confirmation.
sources.local_note: Subscription Offers: Proof of Purchase. Banking Offers: Proof of Deposit. Crypto Offers: Deposit Slips, Trading History. Casino Offers: Deposit Slips, Wagering History.

sources.title: What are Held Offers?
sources.claim: Held offers: automated system prevents reward issuance; causes random manual verification and chargeback rate >10%; shown as Pending; no estimated release time; cannot be released early; paid automatically after checks.
caveats: Read via WebFetch summarizer; paraphrased.
sources.local_note: We manually check a number of random completed offers each day. When chargeback rate exceeds 10% of total offers, offers are held. Held offers display as Pending.

sources.title: What does 'Date Pending' mean?
sources.claim: 'Date Pending' means no release date; if chargeback rate exceeds 10%, completed offers are held, not added to balance, cannot be withdrawn until rate drops below 10%.
caveats: Read via WebFetch summarizer; paraphrased.
sources.local_note: If your chargeback rate exceeds 10%, your completed offers will be held. Rewards are not added to your balance and cannot be withdrawn.

sources.title: Can Freecash release held offers early?
sources.claim: Held offers cannot be released early; held for fraud team investigation; reward appears as pending balance in Cashouts section; paid automatically when lifted; no ticket needed.
sources.local_note: the reward for any held offer appears as a pending balance in the Cashouts section of your account.

sources.title: What is a chargeback?
sources.claim: Chargeback = penalty for fraudulent offer completion; reward deducted from balance; can be issued up to 90 days after crediting; examples: repeating offer, multiple accounts, VPN/proxy/VPS, incorrect info; >10% chargeback rate holds rewards; no ban for a chargeback.
sources.local_note: These chargebacks can be issued up to 90 days after an offer has been credited.

sources.title: How to claim offer rewards
sources.claim: Claim button for one-time task rewards (only on some accounts); daily/repeatable rewards auto-credit; cashout page shows Unclaimed next to Pending balance; League Points and lottery tickets added on claim; some rewards held as Pending.
caveats: Feature rolling out; only some accounts.
sources.local_note: Unclaimed rewards are waiting for you to tap Claim. Pending rewards are being checked before they reach your balance.

sources.title: How to start your first offer
sources.claim: Create account with Google, Facebook, or email; Earn page lists game testing tasks, surveys, other offers (signup deals, paid trials); offer page shows requirements and payout; game tasks redirect to app store; allow tracking; cash out on Cashout page.
sources.local_note: Other offers like signup deals, paid trials, and more. Select a game or offer to view details. This page shows exactly what you need to do and how much you'll get paid.

sources.title: Can I use Freecash if I'm underage?
sources.claim: Must be at least 16 years old (quotes Terms).
sources.local_note: You cannot use Freecash unless you are at least 16 years old

sources.title: Can multiple people in the same household have an account?
sources.claim: One Freecash account per household (and per person).
sources.local_note: Participation on the Website is limited to only one (1) account per person and only (1) account per household.

sources.title: Can I use a VPN or proxy?
sources.claim: VPNs, proxies and iCloud Private Relay prohibited; may result in ban; legally obligated to prevent fraud on behalf of offer providers.
sources.local_note: We strictly prohibit the use of VPNs ... or proxies when using Freecash, doing so may result in your account being banned. This includes iCloud Private Relay.

sources.title: How ID verification works
sources.claim: Identity verification through Veriff: photo of government-issued ID and selfie; usually minutes; refusal grounds for denying rewards/access.
sources.local_note: We have partnered with Veriff ... Veriff will prompt you to take a photo of your Government Issued Identification and a take a selfie.

sources.title: Alternative methods to verify identity
sources.claim: No alternative verification options; Veriff uses AI and deletes data after three years; unverified users cannot redeem.
sources.local_note: we do not offer alternative verification options. Our partners at Veriff ... delete all user data after three years.

sources.title: How to verify email
sources.claim: Verification email sent at signup; resend from Profile > Settings.
sources.local_note: When you first sign up for Freecash, the system will automatically send an email ... containing a verification link.

sources.title: How to enable 2FA
sources.claim: Email-based 6-digit code 2FA from Profile > Settings > Security; code valid 30 minutes; 60-second resend; 5 wrong attempts lock; risk-based codes for new device/IP; rolling out gradually.
caveats: Not yet on every account.
sources.local_note: logging in requires both your password and a 6-digit code sent to your email ... We're rolling out 2FA gradually.

sources.title: Why am I disqualified from surveys?
sources.claim: Most disqualifications are because user is outside a market research partner's target demographic; dishonest/inconsistent answers screened by automated systems; ad blockers/VPN, timeouts cause disqualification.
sources.local_note: users are disqualified from surveys because they are not part of the target demographic ... there's nothing you can do to qualify.

sources.title: Can you get paid to scroll TikTok?
sources.claim: Freecash has no feature paying to watch/scroll TikTok; affiliate ads claiming hourly rate are false; real TikTok offers are install-and-register for new users only.
sources.local_note: A small number of these affiliates have used misleading claims, including the idea that Freecash pays an hourly rate for watching or scrolling TikTok. These claims are false.

sources.title: Loot.tv, Hideout and TimeWall guide
sources.claim: Video-watching providers (Loot.tv via Lootably; Hideout.tv/Petclips via AdscendMedia videos section; TimeWall) require linking a separate provider account to Freecash.
caveats: Reward rates not described.
sources.local_note: Choose the videos section, and scroll down until you find the Hideout.tv options.

sources.title: How to contact AdGem
sources.claim: Issues with offers on AdGem offerwall handled via AdGem 'Reward Status' / contact page from Offer Partners section.
sources.local_note: To contact AdGem regarding an issue with an Offer hosted on their Offerwall ... click the 'Reward Status' option.

sources.title: Make Money Testing Products
sources.claim: Sign Up with Google, Facebook, Apple; product testing = trying an app, game, subscription or online service; reward shown before start; rewarded after confirmation; examples include fintech/crypto (Chime, Binance, Coinbase), Amazon Prime; claims 108M+ users.
caveats: Marketing/self-published claim; not independent proof.
User count 108M+ conflicts with 80M+ elsewhere.
sources.local_note: Choose what interests you, complete the requirements, and get rewarded after confirmation. ... fintechs like Chime ... crypto and finance apps like Binance and Coinbase.

sources.title: Make Money Downloading Apps
sources.claim: Download apps (TikTok, Coinbase, Acorns, Netflix, Monopoly Go!) for rewards; 'earning potential is unlimited'; 'cashout within minutes'.
caveats: Marketing/self-published claim; not independent proof.
sources.local_note: earn rewards for each download! From TikTok to Coinbase, Acorns, Netflix, and so much more, your Freecash earning potential is unlimited.

sources.title: Make Money Completing Free Trials
sources.claim: Earn rewards by trying free trials from apps and services; 'You can cancel anytime'.
caveats: Marketing/self-published claim; not independent proof.
Does not state that trials may convert to paid subscriptions.
sources.local_note: Earn rewards by trying free trials from top apps and services. You can cancel anytime.

sources.title: Make Money Playing Games
sources.claim: Game offers (Monopoly GO, Raid: Shadow Legends) on PC, iOS, Android, tablet, browser with personalized offers by platform.
caveats: Marketing/self-published claim; not independent proof.
sources.local_note: Enjoy your favorite games on PC, iOS, Android, your tablet, or simply on the browser.

sources.title: Cashback explained
sources.claim: Cashback shopping via partner-shop tracking links; currently only available in Germany; Pending until shop confirms (days to months); calculated on net amount.
caveats: Dated Oct 2025; terms say cashback may be available only in certain regions.
sources.local_note: Cashback is a new feature on Freecash ... currently only available in Germany.

sources.title: How do I level up?
sources.claim: Each level requires earning $1; levels permanent; offers visible depend on region, not level.
sources.local_note: Each level requires earning $1. ... what you can see depends on your region, not your level.

sources.title: Minimum requirements
sources.claim: iOS 16.4+, Android 8.0+, Safari 16.4+, Chrome/Edge/Firefox 111+.
caveats: Conflicts with Android 5.0 in CR-FC-52.
sources.local_note: Android: Minimum required: Android 8.0 (Oreo) or later.

sources.title: Does Freecash have a Google Play app?
sources.claim: Android app on Google Play; runs on Android 5.0 and later; bonus reward for installing Android app.
caveats: Conflicts with CR-FC-51.
sources.local_note: The Freecash app can run on Android 5.0 and later

sources.title: Does Freecash have an iOS app?
sources.claim: iOS app live on App Store as of 2026 after earlier removals ('Make Money: Freecash Rewards').
sources.local_note: It returned to the store after earlier removals, and as of 2026, it is live on both the App Store and Google Play.

sources.title: What to do if cashouts are paused
sources.claim: Cashouts can be paused for suspected VPN, multiple accounts or ToS breach; not a ban; often restored within 48 hours via support chat; restoration not guaranteed.
sources.local_note: This is not a ban, and in most cases we can restore your ability to cashout within 48 hours.

sources.title: How many coins equal a dollar (search snippet)
sources.page_scope: Academy support article (search index snippet only)
sources.claim: Search snippet from official domain: $1 USD equals 1000 Freecash Coins (1 coin = $0.001).
caveats: Direct fetch returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-10 (es and en variants); only search snippet observed; may be retired.
Current help/cashout pages express balances and minimums in dollars.
sources.local_note: Search snippet: $1 USD equivales to 1000 Freecash Coins; one Freecash Coin is worth $0.001. Page 404 on direct fetch.

sources.title: How to delete your account
sources.claim: Delete account in Settings by typing DELETE; personal data not automatically deleted; GDPR deletion request via support processed within 30 days.
sources.local_note: No, your data is not automatically deleted when you close an account.

sources.title: Free Crypto (Academy cashout landing page)
sources.claim: Earn rewards in BTC, DOGE or LTC.
caveats: Marketing/self-published claim; not independent proof.
Omits Ethereum although ETH withdrawal article exists (CR-FC-58).
sources.local_note: Earn rewards in BTC, DOGE or LTC on Freecash by playing games, completing surveys, or testing products.

sources.title: How to withdraw Ethereum
sources.claim: Direct ETH withdrawal to address in USD amount; usually within an hour; Travel Rule sender Almedia GmbH.
caveats: No minimum or fee stated.
sources.local_note: Requests are usually processed within an hour. However, depending on blockchain congestion, it may take a few hours.

sources.title: How Tango powers your Freecash rewards
sources.claim: Tango (payment partner) processes withdrawals enabling gift cards and PayPal.
caveats: Newer articles (CR-FC-07) say most withdrawals now via Tremendous; Tango is legacy.
sources.local_note: Freecash is excited to introduce our new payment partner, Tango!

sources.title: Freecash Academy sitemap
sources.claim: Lists support articles including offer-partner contact pages (BitLabs, AdGate, AdGem, AdscendMedia, Ayet Studios, Lootably, MM Wall, Monlix, Notik, Revlum, RevU, TimeWall, Torox), survey partners (TapResearch, CPX), streaks, daily bonus ladder, open case, leagues, lottery rules, affiliate system, Emerald Circle.
caveats: Sitemap URLs only establish article existence, not content.
sources.local_note: academy/en/support/offer/offer-partners/how-contact-torox; .../surveys/survey-partners/how-contact-cpx; .../account/rewards/how-affiliate-system-works

sources.title: Contacting survey partners
sources.claim: Survey issues: Profile > Surveys in-Progress > green ticket icon next to survey.
sources.local_note: select the 'Surveys in-Progress' option and find the survey you had issue with. You should then select the green ticket icon

sources.title: What does Freecash do with survey data?
sources.claim: Demographic data used only for survey matching and not shared beyond survey partners.
sources.local_note: Your data is only used for survey matching purposes and is not shared beyond our survey partners.

sources.title: Removing offers from Started Offers list
sources.claim: Started offers cannot be manually removed; auto-removed after 60 days; no limit on concurrent offers.
sources.local_note: these offers will be automatically removed after 60 days. ... there is no upper limit on the number of offers you can begin at once.
